title: apps/console/docs/UI_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL.md:167 documents a `direction` prop on ResizablePanelGroup — the exported component takes `orientation`
body:
Found while measuring #6600 (pointing the documentation gates' collectors at `apps/*/docs/**` without changing any gate). Recording only; ⛔ not fixed there — #6600's file surface excludes `apps/console/docs/**`, and the 2026-08-27 triage on that card says a real defect found in a guide is to be **reported, not fixed**, by the measuring seat.

## The defect

`apps/console/docs/UI_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL.md`, section 3.1 "Resizable Panel", block at `:165`:

```
import { ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup } from '@object-ui/components';

ResizablePanelGroup  direction="horizontal"   <- the prop the guide teaches
```

The import **resolves** — no `TS2307`, the names are real exports — but the prop does not exist. Compiled by `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`'s own `compileSnippets()` against the built `dist` types (controls held: resolution landed on `packages/types/dist/index.d.ts`, sentinel `TS2305`, positive 0, `srcLeaks` 0):

```
TS2322: Type '{ children: Element[]; direction: string; }' is not assignable to type
'IntrinsicAttributes & HTMLAttributes(HTMLDivElement) & { children?: ReactNode; className?: string | undefined; ... 10 more ...; style?: CSSProperties | undefined; }'.
Property 'direction' does not exist on type ...
```

The real spelling is **`orientation`**, and it is deliberate rather than incidental — the repository has a test named for it:

- `packages/components/src/ui/resizable.tsx:44` — the component declaration
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/resizable-orientation.test.tsx:52` — `ResizablePanelGroup orientation={orientation}`
- `packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx:519` — an in-tree call site using `orientation="horizontal"`

So the guide is the half that is wrong, not the component.

## Why it is worth a card

This is the second concrete thing to fall out of the `apps/console/docs/**` blind spot #6600 records (the first was `error-tracking.md`, rewritten in #6599). A reader who copies section 3.1 gets a type error on the first prop. Nothing mechanical could have noticed: all three documentation gates root their walk at `content/docs`, so no gate has ever opened this file.

Of the 14 `ts`/`tsx` blocks in that tree, this is the **only** finding that is a defect in what the prose claims. The other 10 red blocks are excerpt fragments (undeclared identifiers, an unclosed JSX element) — a document-shape question that belongs to #6600's proposal, not here.

## Scope note

`UI_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL.md` is an aspirational design proposal, not shipped operator prose, so whoever picks this up should decide first whether the file is still live. If it is, fix the prop; if it is not, retiring the file closes this too.
